mechanism.claim: The volatility of market liquidity commands a positive, time-varying cryptocurrency risk premium. During elevated BTC realized variation, an upper-tail daily innovation in intraday Amihud-liquidity volatility maps long and a lower-tail innovation maps short for the next day.
mechanism.side: long when the signed liquidity-volatility innovation rank is at least 0.80; short when it is at most 0.20
mechanism.why_distinct: HVALPR ranked the level innovation of daily mean Amihud illiquidity and HVLIR ranked one hourly price-impact level. HVLVPR instead measures the within-day second moment of 288 five-minute Amihud observations, then ranks the signed change in that liquidity-risk state. It uses no completed return direction, flow, basis, OI, funding, fitted outcome, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed daily BTC realized-variation rank must be in its causal upper 35%, targeting July-like unstable markets
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse daily liquidity-risk innovation clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every calendar day at exact 00:00 UTC
features.window: 288 exact coherent five-minute groups from 1,440 BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-24h,D)
features.five_minute_quote_turnover: sum quote_asset_volume, finite strict positive in every group
features.five_minute_amihud: abs(five-minute return)/five-minute quote turnover, finite nonnegative
features.daily_liquidity_volatility: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of all 288 five-minute Amihud observations, finite strict positive
features.reference: median log daily liquidity volatility over thirty exact source-valid days ending strictly before current day
features.innovation: log(current daily liquidity volatility)-strictly-prior thirty-day median log liquidity volatility, finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute returns), finite strict positive
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midranks of innovation and variation over at most 180 earlier source-valid days, minimum 120, current excluded
features.source_validity: exact distinct minute grid, finite positive coherent OHLC, finite positive quote turnover, no imputation

clock.feature_available: 00:00 UTC after the completed daily window
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: paper-reported volatility-of-liquidity premium expressed as a fixed transparent second-moment innovation state

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no liquidity measure, intraday aggregation, reference window, rank history, tail, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.paper: Cryptocurrency returns and the volatility of liquidity
external_basis.author: Thomas Leirvik
external_basis.reported_relation: positive but highly time-varying relation between idiosyncratic volatility of cryptocurrency market liquidity and expected returns
external_basis.untested_adaptation: five-minute Binance perpetual Amihud observations, within-day sample volatility, prior-median signed innovation, two-sided ranks, high-variation gate, and one-day BTC hold are a transparent causal adaptation rather than a claimed replication
